newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Firmer undertone to cash cattle with boxed beef values also up.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Large advance in CME index and corn futures expected lower.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Steady to higher cash hog indications on lighter runs and advance in pork complex.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Carryover seen on firmer cash and reduced hog slaughter rate.
